title: Wild Rebellion
headline:
From a drawing.
To a world you can play.
summary: Step into Lilly’s stories, race your friends, grow a thriving farm, and explore a world full of characters, quests, and surprises.

hero.alt: Wild Rebellion characters standing together in the village
hero.caption: Wild Rebellion game artwork.

intro: Wild Rebellion began with Lilly’s drawings and the stories she gave her characters. Those ideas became animated episodes, then a Roblox world where you can step into the adventure yourself.

Follow the heroes or the villains, take on Episode 3 and 4 adventures, and explore the water park and cinema. Between story moments, race at Kart Park, tend your crops, visit village homes, or take a dragon into the sky.

features.title: Choose your side of the story
features.text: Axi’s heroes work to break the shadow spell and free their friends. Madhattr’s villains bring their own perspective from the Chaos Lair. The same world gives you different reasons to explore.

image.alt: The Wild Rebellion villains in their lair
image.caption: Villains and the Chaos Lair, from the game’s existing media gallery.

features.title: Make room for a little everyday magic
features.text: The village is a place to return to. Meet its characters, visit their homes, and build up your farm through crop care, deliveries, ranks, and permanent upgrades.

image.alt: Exploration in the Wild Rebellion village
image.caption: A look at Wild Rebellion’s open world.

features.title: Follow your next adventure
features.text: Race friends or CPU racers at Kart Park, explore the Episode 4 water park, or fly toward Bobcat Island. Story chapters, fishing, treasure hunts, and parkour give you a different reason to head out each time.

image.caption: Bobcat Island and the skyward side of Wild Rebellion.

steps: Start with the in-game introduction and follow the first objectives before heading farther into the world.
Talk to characters and visit their homes. Quest markers give your exploring a purpose.
Choose a story chapter, head to Kart Park, or settle into a farming routine. Your quest panel is there whenever you want a next objective.
characters: The hero at the heart of the rescue story.
The villain leader at the center of the Chaos Lair.
The shadow weaver whose spell drives the conflict.
A familiar guide to the village and its story.
creation: Lilly supplies the imagination; drawings, animated storytelling, game building, music, and family playtesting turn it into a place you can visit.
faq: Is this the same world as Lilly’s videos?
Yes. The Roblox game and Wild Rebellion episodes share Lilly’s characters and world. The videos below include gameplay, character explanations, and the story behind the project.
Do I need to watch the episodes first?
No. Start in Roblox and follow the introduction. The videos add context to the characters and how the world came together.
How do I get a new update?
Open the Roblox experience to join a server. Newly published builds reach new servers; an older running server can still be on an earlier version.

title: Monstrum World: Battle Academy
eyebrow: Raise a partner. Build a team.
headline:
Small companions.
A much bigger adventure.
summary: A monster-raising RPG where the time you spend training, caring, exploring, and battling shapes the team that grows alongside you.

hero.alt: Illustrated Monstrum World companions beside a ranch
hero.caption: Promotional illustration. See the battle screenshots below for in-game visuals.

intro: Monstrum World puts the ranch at the center of a creature-raising adventure. Hatch or capture a companion, train it, look after it, then take your team into the world to battle and discover what comes next.

The published game description lists 126 species, 2,236 collectible forms, and a 40-chapter story across eight acts. The interesting part is the relationship between those systems: care prepares your team for adventure, and adventure brings home the resources for its next stage.

features.title: A ranch worth coming home to
features.text: Training, rest, feeding, and cooking all have a role in caring for your companions. Coach Juniper’s kitchen lets you turn ingredients collected in the world into treats, dishes, and meals. Choose food for the care or recovery your team needs.

image.alt: Illustration of three companion creatures at the ranch
image.caption: Promotional artwork for Monstrum World.

features.title: Battles with decisions to make
features.text: Bring your rancher and two companions into speed-based Active Time Battles. Choose attacks, skills, items, and traps, or use the available automatic tactics. Elemental matchups, your team’s condition, and the timing of your choices all matter.

image.alt: An in-game Active Time Battle with two companions
image.caption: Earlier development capture of the battle system; interface details have since changed.

features.title: Build the next generation
features.text: Training and care influence evolution. Fusion lets you choose parents, preview an offspring, and select inherited moves. The October interface update gives parent selection and the offspring preview their own steps on smaller screens.

image.alt: Earlier Monstrum World battle controls in a phone-sized viewport
image.caption: Earlier Studio phone-layout capture, before the October interface improvements.

steps: Follow the introduction and visit the ranch services. Start with a hatch or capture, then learn the companion’s condition and care needs.
Mix training with food and rest. Collect ingredients while exploring, then return to Juniper to see what you can cook.
Follow story objectives, explore regions, and enter battles. As your team grows, explore evolution, fusion, tournaments, and expeditions.
characters: Your point of contact for companion care, healing, and cooking.
A guide to getting started and learning the ranch.
creation: The development story is about connecting systems: giving a companion a life at the ranch, making its growth matter in battle, and keeping those choices understandable on a small screen.
faq: What makes it a monster-raising game?
Your companions need more than a place in a collection. Training, food, rest, evolution, and fusion connect the ranch routine to the team you take into battle.
Where is the new cooking system?
Visit Coach Juniper at the ranch. The kitchen shows recipes, ingredient requirements, shortages, and the effects of the food you can prepare.
